mapping.strategy: Official English MHFU overlay is canonical (ETL name_en). CSV/TeamHGG strings alias onto that overlay, plus packs/mhfu/name_aliases.yaml for typos/forum names. Narga/Naruga is applied as a mechanical extra. name_en must exist in the loaded pack. fully_mapped also requires Pass A (sockets + positive skill points).
